1 Brower with 2 Methods to Archive Online & Offline Easily

If you have the Opera browser you can easily have 2 methods at your fingertips for saving these articles and more at all times. There are 2 extensions that you can get for the Opera browser (you may have to download the Opera browser if you don't already have it.).

Wayback Everywhere

This is the first extension you can use which will back up most pages to the archive.org website. However, sometimes it cannot do this (possibly due to site settings) so you have to go to archive.org and copy/paste the URL to archive it. Occasionally, you can pause Wayback to load certain sites that won't load until you do. Then, once they are loaded, you can unpause it and capture it. This sometimes works and sometimes doesn't.

Printliminator

The other extension is for your own offline storage and is called Printliminator. It will let you "print" the entire webpage (without having to scroll to capture the entire page). You can either print it to paper or change the setting on the print window that opens and tell it to save the entire page as a pdf. And, it'll even let you clean up the page by eliminating sections from the "frame" of the webpage if you have print obscuring the article in the print preview. Printliminator has worked for me every time so far. I specifically use both of these for archiving on and offline quickly and easily (in most cases regarding Wayback).

How to Add Extensions to Opera

Opera is easy to use and so is adding these two apps to it. (This is the Windows 10 pc method, not mobile.) You should be able to have them up and running fairly quickly. Once you have Opera downloaded and open, click on the "O" in the upper left-hand corner and a menu will pop-up. You'll see "extensions" in the list. Hover over it and another little window with a menu will open to the right. Click on "Get Extensions". This will take you to a search screen. Just type in the names of the 2 extensions above and follow the instructions. If you run into problems just do a search for "adding Printliminator to Opera browser" or "adding Wayback Everywhere to Opera browser" and you should find easy instructions for setting them up.
